description: Defines classes and structures for managing frame timestamps and event histories in Android's graphics pipeline, including FrameEvents, FrameEventHistory, ProducerFrameEventHistory, ConsumerFrameEventHistory, FrameEventsDelta, and FrameEventHistoryDelta.

classes.name: FrameEvents
classes.description: Represents timestamps for a single frame, including various lifecycle points and fences.

classes.name: FrameEventHistory
classes.description: Manages a history of FrameEvents, providing access and management functions.

classes.name: ProducerFrameEventHistory
classes.description: Producer-side interface for managing frame event history, including deadlines and fences.

classes.name: NewFrameEventsEntry
classes.description: Represents a new frame event record created by the consumer.

classes.name: FrameEventDirtyFields
classes.description: Tracks which frame event fields have been modified or sent.

classes.name: ConsumerFrameEventHistory
classes.description: Consumer-side interface for managing frame event history, including adding and delta calculation.

classes.name: FrameEventsDelta
classes.description: Represents a delta update of frame events from consumer to producer.

classes.name: FrameEventHistoryDelta
classes.description: Collection of FrameEventsDelta objects representing updates to frame event history.

methods.name: isValidTimestamp
methods.description: Checks if a timestamp is valid (not pending).

methods.name: getReportedCompositeDeadline
methods.description: Returns the composite deadline from the compositor timing.

methods.name: updateAcquireFence
methods.description: Updates the acquire fence for a specific frame.

methods.name: addQueue
methods.description: Adds a new frame queue entry.

methods.name: addLatch
methods.description: Adds latch time for a frame.

methods.name: getAndResetDelta
methods.description: Retrieves and resets the delta of frame events.
